triples.tail_surface: in accordance with the manufacturer’s assembly instructions
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 按照制造商装配说明安装
triples.evidence_text: The installation of mechanical pipe joints, as covered by 4-6-2/5.5.5 and 4-6-2/5.9, is to be in accordance with the manufacturer’s assembly instructions.

triples.tail_surface: specified and supplied as necessary by the manufacturer
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 由制造商按需指定并提供
triples.evidence_text: Where special tools and gauges are required for installation of the joints, these are to be specified and supplied as necessary by the manufacturer.

triples.head_surface: pipes penetrate watertight bulkheads, decks or tank-tops
triples.head_canonical_zh: 管道穿过水密舱壁、甲板或内底板
triples.tail_surface: bolted connections are to have bolts threaded into the plating from one side; through bolts are not to be used
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 螺栓连接须从一侧旋入板中且不得使用贯穿螺栓
triples.evidence_text: Where it is necessary for pipes to penetrate watertight bulkheads, decks or tank-tops, the penetrations are to be made by methods which will maintain the watertight integrity. For this purpose, bolted connections are to have bolts threaded into the plating from one side; through bolts are not to be used.

triples.head_surface: pipes penetrate watertight bulkheads, decks or tank-tops
triples.head_canonical_zh: 管道穿过水密舱壁、甲板或内底板
triples.tail_surface: Welded connections are either to be welded on both sides or to have full penetration welds from one side
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 焊接连接应双面焊或单面全熔透焊
triples.evidence_text: Welded connections are either to be welded on both sides or to have full penetration welds from one side.

triples.head_surface: pipes penetrate bulkheads, decks or tank-tops which are required to be fire tight or smoke tight
triples.head_canonical_zh: 管道穿过要求防火或防烟的舱壁、甲板或内底板
triples.tail_surface: approved methods which will maintain the same degree of fire tight or smoke tight integrity
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 采用能保持同等防火或防烟完整性的认可方法
triples.evidence_text: Where pipes penetrate bulkheads, decks or tank-tops which are required to be fire tight or smoke tight, the penetrations are to be made by approved methods which will maintain the same degree of fire tight or smoke tight integrity.

triples.head_surface: collision bulkhead may be pierced below the bulkhead deck by not more than one pipe
triples.head_canonical_zh: 防撞舱壁在舱壁甲板以下仅允许穿一根管
triples.tail_surface: fitted with a screwdown or butterfly valve capable of being operated from above the bulkhead deck
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 装设可从舱壁甲板以上操作的截止阀或蝶阀
triples.evidence_text: the collision bulkhead may be pierced below the bulkhead deck by not more than one pipe for dealing with fluid in the forepeak tank, provided that the pipe is fitted with a screwdown or butterfly valve capable of being operated from above the bulkhead deck

triples.tail_surface: open/closed indicators locally and above the bulkhead deck
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 本地及舱壁甲板以上的开/关指示器
triples.evidence_text: The valve is to have open/closed indicators locally and above the bulkhead deck.
Gray cast iron valves are not acceptable.

triples.tail_surface: No valves or cocks for sluicing (draining) are to be fitted on a collision bulkhead
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 禁止在防撞舱壁上装设冲洗（排放）用阀或旋塞
triples.evidence_text: No valves or cocks for sluicing (draining) are to be fitted on a collision bulkhead.

triples.head_surface: valves are fitted onto watertight bulkheads directly without piping on either side for sluicing, drainage or liquid transfer
triples.head_canonical_zh: 直接装于水密舱壁上且两侧无管路的冲洗、排放或液体输送阀
triples.tail_surface: readily accessible at all times and are to be operable (open and close) from a position above the bulkhead deck
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 随时易于接近并可从舱壁甲板以上位置操作启闭
triples.evidence_text: Where valves are fitted onto watertight bulkheads directly without piping on either side for sluicing, drainage or liquid transfer, the valves are to be readily accessible at all times and are to be operable (open and close) from a position above the bulkhead deck.

triples.tail_surface: Indicators are to be provided to show whether the valves are open or closed
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 设置指示器以显示阀门开启或关闭状态
triples.evidence_text: Indicators are to be provided to show whether the valves are open or closed.
